meta.description: Stable-isotope-resolved metabolomics with 13C/15N/2H tracers, correction, MID/enrichment, and steady-state versus INST-MFA decisions.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numeric results were computed from synthetic arrays or AccuCor bundled reference data; no external scientific result was invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: All outputs remain bench metabolomics analysis and make no diagnostic, prescribing, or treatment conclusion.

methodological_ground.detail: The audit verifies correction before interpretation, derivative sensitivity, pool-versus-flux separation, positional-tracer routing, and the four-timepoint classical-MFA guard.

code_usability.detail: Six saved executable audit paths plus a copied shipped example ran successfully with isocor 2.2.4 and accucor 0.3.1.9000.

functional_suitability.note: All promised correction, tracer-choice, MID, and steady-state/MFA paths are covered.

reliability.note: Live normal, malformed, derivative, and short-series checks produced actionable behavior.

performance_context.note: Concise Skill, usage guide, and example avoid redundant workflow loops.

agent_usability.note: Current snippets supply explicit status strings and preventive guidance.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language and decision tree are strong; dependency errors remain plain ValueErrors.

security.note: No credentials, raw-code execution, destructive action, or sensitive retention path is present.

maintainability.note: Skill, guide, and example separate concerns; one shipped fixture limits breadth.

agent_specific.note: Trigger boundaries, deterministic operations, and explicit handoffs are clear.

Live IsoCor evidence covers 13C low-resolution, 15N, derivative formula sensitivity, malformed clusters, and the documented factory-selection error.
AccuCor output-base isolation matched its bundled reference while the documented high-resolution call also completed.
The Skill correctly separates pool concentration from flux and routes transient labeling to INST-MFA.
